proposed_widenings.name: grant_feat category choice / any_qualifying_feat
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing class_feature passive family fits, but the current grant_feat payload only allows one fixed feat category. This rule grants one feat chosen from either Epic Boon feats or another qualifying feat, which cannot be represented honestly as a single fixed category.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain an Epic Boon feat (see "Feats") or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

notes: Stopped before authoring content/bard_epic_boon_l19.dhall. The unit fits class_feature + passive, but current grant_feat is too narrow to encode the choice without a misleading trace. The recommendation for Boon of Spell Recall is advisory only.
